blurb: Boulder City Golf Course offers an 18-hole, par 72 layout measuring 6,600 yards with tree-lined fairways and water features on 7 holes. The course is designed for all skill levels and rounds typically take 4.5 hours or less. Boulder Creek Golf Club offers a 27-hole facility with three 9-hole courses: Desert Hawk, Coyote Run, and Eldorado Valley, each with unique terrain and challenges.
